items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to confront Pharaoh and demand the release of the Israelites

items.quote: lo, he cometh forth to the water
items.claim: Pharaoh comes forth to the water
